title: TestReport
description: Aggregate report produced by the H3 compliance test battery (`h3-test --json` in the get-h3/shim plugin). Two shapes share this schema: a normal run (results/total/passed/failed/duration_ms/timestamp/all_passing/latency) and a refused run against a target that is not an H3 endpoint (warning/endpoint/not_h3_endpoint/reason plus empty counters).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the report was generated.

latency.description: Per-test latency statistics (milliseconds) over `results`. Optional in the contract but always written by the current producer (`h3-test --json`), including the refused-run shape where an empty results list yields all zeros. Kept optional so an emitter that serialises the report without latency statistics (e.g. `report_as_dict()`) remains valid.

warning.description: Human-readable warning. Present only on the refused-run shape (target is not an H3 endpoint).

endpoint.description: Base URL of the target that was probed. Present only on the refused-run shape.

not_h3_endpoint.description: True when the battery refused to run because the target does not expose an H3-shaped /v1/health endpoint. Present only on the refused-run shape; the CLI exits 2 in that case.

reason.description: Reason the target was rejected, e.g. 'connection error: All connection attempts failed' or 'status 404 Not Found: <body snippet>'. Present only on the refused-run shape.

harness.description: RESERVED / forward-looking extension point. No current producer emits this object — the battery CLI reports the probed target as the top-level `endpoint` field on the refused-run shape and does not echo harness metadata on a normal run. Retained in the 1.x contract so code generated from this schema keeps compiling; do not populate it in an emitter without a protocol minor-version bump.

endpoint.description: Base URL of the harness tested.

TestResult.title: TestResult
TestResult.description: Outcome of a single compliance test.

LatencyStats.title: LatencyStats
LatencyStats.description: Nearest-rank latency statistics (milliseconds) over the duration_ms of every test result in the report. An empty results list yields all zeros.

mean_ms.description: Arithmetic mean of every test duration.
